import numpy as np
values = np.array([5.0, 2.0, 0.4, 0.05])
S = np.block([[np.zeros((4,4)), -np.diag(values)], [np.diag(values), np.zeros((4,4))]])
Q0 = np.eye(8)
for p, q, theta in [(0,5,0.37),(2,7,-0.52),(1,4,0.81),(3,6,-0.28),(0,2,0.44)]:
    G = np.eye(8)
    c, s = np.cos(theta), np.sin(theta)
    G[p,p] = G[q,q] = c
    G[p,q], G[q,p] = -s, s
    Q0 = Q0 @ G
A = Q0 @ S @ Q0.T
seed = 314159
assert np.allclose(compute_basis_sensitive_skew_scalar(A, seed), target)
